thread:
sam: Heads-up — Azure Marketplace + SI partner want a focused workshop next Wed to agree on HSM BYO flow for private listings. Goal: finalize attestation checklist, packaging for private offers, and a simple test harness. Who should own the tech agenda?
jess: +1. Recommend split: 60m tech deep-dive (attestation, PKCS#11/Cloud KMS mapping, allowed APIs) then 30m GTM/marketplace ops. Invite Jeroen (security) and Priya (partner PM). :thumbsup:
kavi: I can own the tech agenda. We should bring a minimal smoke-test that partners can run during the call. Example PKCS#11 probe:```pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so -L && pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so -O```This validates token listing + object read.
emily: Also need to cover secrets sync patterns (vault -> marketplace listing) and SCIM for provisioning the SI's support accounts. Some customers require SAML metadata exchange + SCIM provisioning before private offers go live.
priya: For the marketplace legal checklist, we need: attestations, encryption-in-transit docs, who signs the ATO, and whether the HSM is BYO or vendor-managed. I'll draft a one-pager.
security-bot: Reminder: include key-rotation cadence and KMS/HSM audit log retention in the spec (per compliance request).
sam: Good call. Action items: kavi = tech smoke-test + short README, priya = legal & ops one-pager, emily = SCIM/SAML integration notes, jess = schedule + invite stakeholders.
jess: I'll send a 90-min invite (60 tech + 30 ops) for Wed 10am PT. Adding Jeroen, Priya, Kavi, Emily, Marketplace PM, and the SI lead.
calendar-bot: Invite sent: "Marketplace HSM BYO workshop" Wed 10:00–11:30 PT — link: https://calendar.company/meeting/abc123 (organizer: jess)
kavi: For the in-call demo, I'll bring a tiny docker image that runs SoftHSM + a pkcs11 probe and a short TLS handshake test to show key usage mapping to our runtime. Will post repo link before EOD.
emily: Can someone confirm who in engineering will own the deployment packaging requirements for private offers? We need a build artifact spec (container, manifest, required ports, env vars).
priya: Ops will need the manifest template. I'll coordinate with eng after the workshop.
sam: If everyone can drop their short deliverables in the shared doc before EOD Monday, we can circulate a consolidated runbook during the call. Link I'm creating: https://docs.internal/marketplace-hsm-byo-workshop
jess: noted. Also — let's include one customer use case to drive the conversation (regulated fintech BYO-HSM + SCIM). That keeps requirements concrete.
security-bot: Suggest adding a quick threat model slide: key compromise scenarios + acceptable mitigations (HSM attestation, remote attestation, limited exportability).
priya: I'll add the threat model and compliance checklist to the one-pager.
sam: Awesome. Last ask — @jess can you include the SI's contact and a short pre-read so they can confirm their PKCS#11/CloudKMS mapping?
jess: Yup sending pre-read now. /cc @kavi please review PKCS11 snippet for accuracy.
kavi: will do. :eyes:
